description: Aquaoct default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/aquaoct-character-sheet.png: the five palette chips (intake.json swatches 215,236,231 / 164,215,206 / 109,178,175 / 75,130,144 / 39,59,64) + k-means clusters of the drawn surfaces (6 clusters per region, sheet px boxes in each note). Pale-aqua glossy egg head with darker-teal spots, cream goggle mask + white beard frill, big dark eyes with a teal iris ring and a white highlight, aqua-topped tentacles with cream-white undersides. No glow anywhere (the sheet draws none). Alternate colours: none yet (default skin only, brief 2026-10-09).

mask.note: goggle mask band: front mask box (130,462)-(276,528) clusters 206,218,206 47% / 230,231,220 20% (lit), weighted
